signals.title: renee-jia/scholar-loop
signals.content: An autonomous AI scientist: a multi-agent loop over literature, experiments, self-critique and write-up, with deterministic guards against reward-hacking and hallucination.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 58. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: renee-jia/scholar-loop
An autonomous AI scientist operates as a multi‑agent loop that continuously scans scholarly literature, designs and runs experiments, critiques its own findings, and drafts reports. Deterministic safeguards are embedded to limit reward‑hacking and reduce hallucination, ensuring outputs remain evidence‑based and verifiable. The system is intended for open‑source intelligence (OSINT) research, with explicit acknowledgment of uncertainty where data are incomplete.
